kurals.tr: Kaadhalar Thoodhotu Vandha Kanavinukku / Yaadhusey Venkol Virundhu
kurals.m: Where with shall I feast the dream which has brought me my dear one's messenger ?

kurals.tr: Kayalunkan Yaanirappath Thunjir Kalandhaarkku / Uyalunmai Saatruven Man
kurals.m: If my fish-like painted eyes should, at my begging, close in sleep, I could fully relate my sufferings to my lord

kurals.tr: Nanavinaal Nalkaa Thavaraik Kanavinaal / Kaantalin Unten Uyir
kurals.m: My life lasts because in my dream I behold him who does not favour me in my waking hours

kurals.tr: Kanavinaan Untaakum Kaamam Nanavinaan / Nalkaarai Naatith Thararku
kurals.m: There is pleasure in my dream, because in it I seek and obtain him who does not visit me in my wakefulness

kurals.tr: Nanavinaal Kantadhooum Aange Kanavundhaan / Kanta Pozhudhe Inidhu
kurals.m: I saw him in my waking hours, and then it was pleasant; I see him just now in my dream, and it is (equally) pleasant

kurals.tr: Nanavena Ondrillai Aayin Kanavinaal / Kaadhalar Neengalar Man
kurals.m: Were there no such thing as wakefulness, my beloved (who visited me) in my dream would not depart from me

kurals.tr: Nanavinaal Nalkaak Kotiyaar Kanavanaal / Enemmaip Peezhip Padhu
kurals.m: The cruel one who would not favour me in my wakefulness, what right has he to torture me in my dreams?

kurals.tr: Thunjungaal Tholmelar Aaki Vizhikkungaal / Nenjaththar Aavar Viraindhu
kurals.m: When I am asleep he rests on my shoulders, (but) when I awake he hastens into my soul

kurals.tr: Nanavinaal Nalkaarai Novar Kanavinaal / Kaadhalark Kaanaa Thavar
kurals.m: They who have no dear ones to behold in their dreams blame him who visits me not in my waking hours

kurals.tr: Nanavinaal Namneeththaar Enpar Kanavinaal / Kaanaarkol Ivvoo Ravar
kurals.m: The women of this place say he has forsaken me in my wakefulness I think they have not seen him visit me in my dreams
